text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with T.M. 
Opera O, as the sun began to set and 
curfew drew near—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, oh no!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To realize such a crucial fact only now... 
What a blunder, entirely unfitting of an 
Overlord!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
An indispensable existence in composing 
the supreme work of art that is myself—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I forgot to buy the red roses to float in 
the bathtub...!!
choice_data_list:
...Curfew is coming up soon, so why not 
give up for today?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Nay! Most decidedly, nay!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To abandon one's own radiance is the 
absolute pinnacle of sloth—an unforgivable 
folly!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now that you understand, why don't we go 
buy roses together?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even at this very moment, the lovely 
flowers in the bath must be longing and 
weeping in sorrow, waiting for the moment 
they can frolic with me...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We have to lend a helping hand as soon as 
possible!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, let us depart!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's hurry up and go buy it!
Yeah, let's hurry and go buy it!

No, let's stick to curfew for your sake 
too.
No, let's keep curfew—for your sake too.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, let us depart!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's hurry up and go buy it!
Yeah, let's hurry and go buy it!

No, let's stick to curfew for your sake 
too.
No, let's keep curfew—for your sake too.

text_block_list.text:
After making her promise to return to the 
academy before curfew, we headed to her 
favorite spot.
And—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Five minutes before curfew... I managed 
to fulfill my tryst with the roses in 
time."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you've realized it anew, haven't 
you? That the "Overlord" is one who keeps 
his promises!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A great, noble, and beautiful being, you 
say? Oh please! Why state the obvious 
after all this time?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I know. To thank you for keeping me 
company today, I shall give you some of 
these roses as well.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Did you know, Trainer? The language of 
flowers for rose leaves is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Don't give up," "You will bring hope back 
home."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think it perfectly describes us 
today?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a weak reaction. I was certain 
you'd be choked up with tears of joy, but—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hah...! Could it be that this is what you 
want to say!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because they already possess the hope that 
is me, that alone is more than enough—!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, you got me there! Fair and square! 
Bwahahahaha!

Afterward, I saw off a high-spirited TM 
Opera O and headed home.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Mmh? What do you mean?
choice_data_list:
If you break curfew, you're in for a 
lecture late into the night.

If you break curfew, you'll get lectured 
late into the night.

text_block_list.text:
When I told her that getting roses 
wouldn't mean a thing if sleep deprivation 
ruined her beauty—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What on earth?!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, how could someone of my stature have 
overlooked something so fundamental...?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Slender, delicate limbs! Silky smooth 
skin to the touch! A dripping-wet, 
stunning Conqueror!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Even though those things can only be 
maintained by leading a disciplined, 
regular life...!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for reminding me. I appreciate 
it, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I feel bad for making my roses wait in 
vain, but I'll make sure to shower them 
with love tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So let's get to sleep early today. Both 
me, and you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Please, let me thank you for the 
advice!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'll come meet you in your dreams tonight, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In a glittering castle surrounded by stars 
and roses, come join me for a dance party!

Picturing that scene was surreal, but I 
felt it was going to be a lively dream.
